summary: Verified end-to-end the 3 new features of this round: (1) PATCH /api/licenses/{install_id}/contact updates only sent fields, empty string clears, returns updated license; (2) verify_license propagates client_meta English + Spanish + accented aliases (company_name/empresa, contact_name/persona_contacto, phone/telefono/teléfono, tax_id/nif/cif, email) to top-level license fields visible in GET list; (3) Admin frontend 'Editar' modal opens with prefilled data, saves via PATCH, closes both modals, refreshes list and re-opens detail with new data. 10/10 pytest tests pass, full Playwright e2e flow passes, no 5xx in backend logs.
critical_code_review_comments: licenses.py > 1650 lines and admin.html > 2070 lines — recommend splitting (already noted in iter28).
PATCH endpoint correctly excludes None (exclude_none=True) so partial updates work; empty string sets field to None. Behaviour matches spec.

_CONTACT_MAP in verify_license (licenses.py:832) correctly lowercases the key before mapping so aliases work regardless of case; NOTE: keys are truncated to 64 chars (str(k)[:64]) but aliases are short so unaffected.
PATCH endpoint is correctly registered as body-model at module scope (UpdateContactBody at line 29) — the previous FastAPI query-param bug is confirmed fixed.
Minor UX: after saveContactEdit closes ALL modal-back nodes via querySelectorAll — if any other unrelated modal were open it would also close (low risk in current UI).
seed_data_creation: Test cases create ephemeral licenses (CD-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX pattern) and delete them in teardown_method / finally block. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features verified working: PATCH contact endpoint (module-scope Pydantic body model fix effective), client_meta alias propagation on /verify (both EN and ES aliases including 'teléfono' with accent and 'cif'), and admin.html 'Editar' modal (data-testid attributes present: edit-client-name, edit-contact-name, edit-email, edit-phone, edit-tax-id, btn-save-contact). Playwright login flow: sessionStorage['mcp.admin.token'] = admin token. Verify endpoint field name is 'key' (not 'license_key'). Generate endpoint returns 201 (not 200). install_id must match CD-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX (4 groups of 4 alnum uppercase).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
